sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Florian Gruber,

Thank you for your offer and the transparency on underlying costs. We recognise the increases you describe; their modest weighted effect, together with our demand outlook, informs our opening proposal.

Our demand forecast for this part has changed +4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).

A multi-year agreement for standard-stock supply fits your standard-range policy and reduces repeated annual negotiations. We are flexible on payment terms, with an option retaining your proposed terms; please choose the package that works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.49 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 4.43 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 4.45 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement.

We look forward to agreeing a straightforward renewal with clear commercial terms.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your proposal and the prospect of a 24-month agreement. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. While we welcome the extended contract term, the price levels you suggested are unfortunately not viable for us. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, we can offer €4.88 per unit for a 24-month agreement with 30 days net payment. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Florian Gruber,

We understand that our proposed prices were not viable for you and appreciate your revised offer and willingness to link terms to price. We have made a modest price concession and look for a corresponding step from you.

We are flexible on contract length: the longer-term option offers a longer commitment in exchange for a lower price than your current offer. The shorter-term option retains the duration you welcomed, while both keep standard-stock supply straightforward; please choose which works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.52 per unit, 24-month agreement, payment 90 days net.
Option B: EUR 4.52 per unit, 36-month agreement, payment 90 days net.

Thank you for considering these packages; we would welcome an agreement on this basis.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your revised offer and the option for a 36-month agreement. While we can accept the longer contract duration, your proposed price level remains unviable for us. 

Therefore, we can offer the 36-month agreement at €4.94 per unit with 90 days net payment. As our current Angebot, we present a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, with a contract term of 36 months: €4.94 per unit, with terms of a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months.

Please note that our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.body:
Dear Florian Gruber,

We recognise that you consider our proposed price unviable and thank you for accepting a longer contract duration. Your price remains unchanged; we are making a modest price concession and expect a corresponding step from you.

We are flexible on contract length: Option B gives you the longer commitment you accepted, reducing repeat negotiations in exchange for a lower price than your current offer. Both packages fit your standard-range policy; please choose which works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.58 per unit, 24-month agreement, payment 90 days net.
Option B: EUR 4.58 per unit, 36-month agreement, payment 90 days net.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We appreciate your consideration of this straightforward renewal proposal.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for reaching out to us. We acknowledge your revised offer, but we are unable to reduce our price and must hold firm at €4.94 per unit. Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, please understand that it is our company policy not to share detailed internal cost structures. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer stands as a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

We are prepared to proceed with the 36-month agreement and 90 days net payment at this price. Alternatively, with a contract term of 36 months: €4.94 per unit, which comes with a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months.

Please note that our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
